keywords.bn: প্রমাণ কীভাবে বোঝা ও বিচার করা হয়
দুই রকম অর্থ হয় না, পরিষ্কার

bangla_explanation: Reliability মানে assessment যেই করুক, যাকেই করুক, ফল একই রকম আসবে।
ভিন্ন candidate, ভিন্ন assessor বা ভিন্ন situations-এও একই methods একইভাবে applied হতে হবে।
এজন্য প্রত্যেক candidate-এর assessment একইভাবে নিতে হয়, instructions পরিষ্কার রাখতে হয়।
"Reliability principles" প্রশ্নে দুটি কথা লিখবেন: practices monitor ও review করা, আর assessor competent হওয়া।

example.en: Two assessors test welding trainees in Dhaka and Khulna. Both use the same checklist and instructions.
example.bn: ঢাকা আর খুলনায় একই checklist ব্যবহার হলে দুই জায়গার ফল তুলনা করা যায়।

list_answer.title: Ways to make assessment reliable

items.text: Administer assessments in the same way for each candidate.

cites.quote: administering assessments in the same way for each candidate

items.text: Make instructions to candidates clear, consistent and unambiguous.

cites.quote: ensuring that instructions to candidates are clear, consistent and unambiguous

items.text: Assessors use well planned guides for observations and for judging evidence.

cites.quote: ensuring that assessors use well planned guides, for observations and for making judgements about evidence

items.text: Make assessment events 'just right': neither too hard nor too easy.

cites.quote: making sure that assessment events are 'just right' neither too hard nor too easy

items.text: Regularly evaluate and revise the assessment tools with other assessors or subject experts.

cites.quote: evaluating and revising the assessment tools and their results with other assessors and/ or subject experts on a regular basis

items_bn: প্রত্যেক candidate-এর assessment একই নিয়মে নিতে হয়, যাতে কেউ আলাদা সুবিধা না পায়।
Candidates-কে দেওয়া instructions পরিষ্কার, সবার জন্য এক এবং দ্ব্যর্থহীন হতে হয়।
Assessors কাজ দেখা ও evidence বিচারের জন্য ভালোভাবে তৈরি guides ব্যবহার করেন, যাতে সবার বিচার একরকম হয়।
Assessment খুব কঠিনও নয়, খুব সহজও নয় — একদম ঠিকঠাক হতে হবে।
অন্য assessors বা subject experts-এর সাথে মিলে নিয়মিত assessment tools যাচাই ও সংশোধন করতে হয়।

traps.text: Reliable: consistently applied with different candidates and assessors. Valid: assess what they claim to assess.

cites.quote: consistently interpreted and applied over time with different candidates, assessors and in various situations
Assessments are valid when they assess what they claim to assess.

traps.text: Do not confuse the reliability principles with how reliability can be improved.

short.prompt: How do you explain "reliability" principles of assessment?
short.modelAnswer:
Reliability: assessment methods and procedures are consistently interpreted and applied over time, with different candidates, assessors and situations.
The reliability principles are:
1. Assessment practices should be monitored and reviewed for consistency in the interpretation of evidence.
2. Assessors must be competent in terms of the national competency standards for assessment.

keyPoints.text: Monitor and review assessment practices for consistency in interpreting evidence.

cites.quote: Assessment practices should be monitored and reviewed to ensure that there is consistency in the interpretation of evidence.

keyPoints.text: Assessors must be competent in the national competency standards for assessment.

cites.quote: Assessors must be competent in terms of the national competency standards for assessment.

keyPoints.text: Reliability holds with different candidates, assessors and in various situations.
